StrataNotice.title: StrataNotice
StrataNotice.description: Represents a strata-related email notice ingested from Gmail, processed, and potentially dispatched.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StrataNotice entity. Corresponds to the email's UID.

subject.description: The subject line of the email notice.

sender.description: The sender's name and email address (e.g., 'Name <email@example.com>') from the email.

receivedAt.description: The date and time the email notice was received.

content.description: The cleaned plain text content of the email notice, after filtering URLs, HTML tags, etc.

html.description: The original HTML content of the email notice. May be empty if not stored.

status.description: The current processing status of the notice. (Enum: 'New', 'Ready', 'Review', 'Dispatched', 'Ignored')

planCode.description: The first strata plan code matched in the email content, used for initial categorization and owner recommendation.

allPlanCodes.description: A JSON array of all unique strata plan codes identified within the email content.

aiSummary.description: A JSON string containing the AI-generated summary of the notice, including 'what', 'when', 'impact', and 'action'.

audience.description: A JSON string containing the AI-generated audience analysis, including 'decision', 'confidence', 'evidence', and 'target_hints'.

attachmentIds.description: References to Attachment entities storing metadata for attachments associated with this notice. (Relationship: StrataNotice 1:N Attachment)

assignedOwnerId.description: Reference to an Owner entity if the notice was dispatched to a single owner. (Relationship: Owner 1:N StrataNotice)

assignedOwnerIds.description: References to Owner entities if the notice was dispatched to multiple owners. (Relationship: Owner N:N StrataNotice)

ownerMessage.description: The AI-generated, owner-facing message derived from the AI summary, ready for dispatch.

Owner.title: Owner
Owner.description: Represents an owner of one or more properties, used for targeted notice dispatch.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Owner entity.

name.description: The full name of the property owner.

email.description: The email address of the property owner.

properties.description: A JSON array of strings, where each string represents a property owned by this person (e.g., 'strataPlanCode - unit').

Property.title: Property
Property.description: Represents a specific property unit, detailing its address and associated strata plan information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Property entity.

propertyName.description: A descriptive name for the property, as provided in the CSV import.

address1.description: The primary street address of the property.

city.description: The city where the property is located.

state.description: The state or province where the property is located.

postalCode.description: The postal or zip code of the property.

strataPlanCode.description: The strata plan code associated with this property.

unitNumber.description: The unit number within the strata plan for this property.

SyncLog.title: SyncLog
SyncLog.description: Records the history and outcome of Gmail synchronization operations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SyncLog entry.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the synchronization operation occurred.

window.description: The number of days back from the current date that emails were searched.

status.description: The outcome status of the synchronization operation. (Enum: 'success', 'fail')

foundCount.description: The total number of emails found during the sync window.

insertedCount.description: The number of new StrataNotice entities successfully inserted into the database.

skippedCount.description: The number of emails skipped due to being duplicates or other filters.

matchedCount.description: The number of emails that matched at least one strata plan code and were considered for insertion.

errorMessage.description: An error message, if the synchronization operation failed.

Attachment.title: Attachment
Attachment.description: Stores metadata for an attachment associated with a StrataNotice.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Attachment metadata entity.

noticeId.description: Reference to the StrataNotice entity this attachment belongs to. (Relationship: StrataNotice 1:N Attachment)

filename.description: The original filename of the attachment.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the attachment (e.g., 'application/pdf', 'image/jpeg').

size.description: The size of the attachment in bytes.

definition.description: Main collection for all ingested and processed strata notices. Reads and writes happen through the trusted server runtime after Firebase Authentication sign-in. Supports queries for Inbox, Sent History, and search features.

params.name: noticeId
params.description: The unique identifier for the StrataNotice entity.

definition.description: Master data collection for property owners. Reads and writes happen through the trusted server runtime after Firebase Authentication sign-in, used for targeted notice dispatch.

params.name: ownerId
params.description: The unique identifier for the Owner entity.

definition.description: Master data collection for individual property units. Reads and writes happen through the trusted server runtime after Firebase Authentication sign-in, providing details for strata plan information.

params.name: propertyId
params.description: The unique identifier for the Property entity.

definition.description: Records the history and outcome of Gmail synchronization operations. Reads and writes happen through the trusted server runtime for system monitoring.

params.name: logId

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for StrataPulse Pro is centered on server-mediated access. All core business entities—StrataNotice, Owner, Property, Attachment, and SyncLog—live in top-level collections, but reads and writes happen through trusted server code that uses the Firebase Admin SDK after a user has signed in with Firebase Authentication.

This model keeps browser clients away from direct Firestore access for live data. Application logic such as dispatch targeting, Gmail sync, and attachment retrieval is enforced on the server, which simplifies the security posture and avoids duplicating authorization logic in Firestore rules. Client-side login proves user identity, while the server owns data access and mutation.

QAP-style filtering still happens cleanly at the application layer. The server can query '/strataNotices' by status, planCode, or receivedAt, and can join owner and property records without exposing direct collection reads to browsers. Structural segregation remains useful because each collection still represents one logical entity, but the trust boundary now sits at the server rather than in client-side Firestore permissions.
